Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosCareNeedDef.label: breathing rescue
Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosCareNeedDef.description: A patient can barely breathe, and something in stock adds to breathing until oxygen or an operation can.

Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosCareNeedDef.label: cure
Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosCareNeedDef.description: A patient has a condition that something in stock removes outright.

Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosCareNeedDef.label: pain relief
Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosCareNeedDef.description: A patient is in severe pain; at extreme pain a sedative may follow when nothing lighter can be given.

Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosCareNeedDef.label: help against a disease
Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosCareNeedDef.description: A patient in bed is losing the race between a disease that can kill and their immunity.

Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosCareNeedDef.label: radiation medicine
Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosCareNeedDef.description: A dosed person needs one of the radiation medicines. Which one, and the doctor's job, are the radiation part's own.

Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosCareNeedDef.label: caught in vacuum
Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosCareNeedDef.description: Someone is caught in vacuum and harmed by it, and carries something that raises vacuum resistance. They take it themselves; no doctor goes in (0.30.0).

Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosCareNeedDef.label: protection from toxins
Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosCareNeedDef.description: Toxic buildup has begun and its source is still around the person: something in stock keeps toxins out while they are there (0.30.0).

Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosCareNeedDef.label: prevention in an outbreak
Phobos.Dosing.Defs.PhobosCareNeedDef.description: A disease that strikes groups is in the colony, and this person is unprotected against it.
